title: Mixed Event — Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles — Episode3 To The Scent Shop!

meta.Event: Memories That Come With The Scent of Candles
meta.Event Outline: Ichika and Nene aren't sure what to give for Valentine's Day. They ask Honami for some advice and decide to make some scented candles together. Meanwhile, Kanade, who has the same concern, also asks Honami for help...

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We arrived a little too early, but it's roundabout the time we agreed to meet.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That reminds me... Mochizuki's supposed to be coming with someone else...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I think she said her name's Kanade Yoisaki... Isn't she...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's the one who helped us that time...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting, Ichika, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hi, Honami. Hi, Kanade.
You came together?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hello, Hoshino. Yes, we did. And...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yeah, it's definitely her...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Um...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um, so...
You're the one who played the piano for us during our New Year's show, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
You performed in that show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. So, thank you very much for helping us out that time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's okay. I just thought that it'd be a shame for the show to have ended there. If anything, thank you for allowing me to participate in such a fun show...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I didn't realize that you two were already acquainted.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Actually, me neither.
This is our first time speaking to one another.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, allow me to reintroduce you two to each other.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um... Kusanagi, this is Kanade Yoisaki.
She's in a group that produces music and she works as the composer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Recently, I got a chance to learn a few things about songwriting from her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Songwriting? That's pretty cool...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And this is Nene Kusanagi.
She's an incredible singer who's been teaching me some tips and tricks from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see.
You must be very talented if Hoshino is your student.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No, um... I'm really not...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
I just thought it was funny how they're both your teachers, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, you're right.
Kusanagi's my singing teacher and Kanade's my songwriting teacher.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And you get to be a teacher and show us how to make our own candles today, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That's right.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, um... Before I forget...
Thank you very much for doing this, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, it's my pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Kusanagi, if you don't mind...
Why don't we try being less formal with one another since I believe we're the same age?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...? O-Oh, okay...
Yeah, that would be easier.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then... Thanks for doing this, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... We're making scented candles together today?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I need to apologize in advance. I don't really know much about them other than that they smell nice...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, same...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, I'll begin explaining how we'll be making our candles. In truth, Ms. Yoisaki's statement mostly covers it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Scented candles are simply candles with scented oils mixed into their wax.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When you light them, the wax melts and the oils release their fragrances to the surroundings.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Scented oils...?
You mean the ones that smell like lavender and cypress...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. This time, we'll be using something called essential oils for the most part, which are natural oils derived from plants...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Depending on which aroma is used, a candle is supposed to help someone focus, relax or even fall asleep.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...? So they don't just smell nice...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A candle's flame also apparently has the ability to calm one's nerves.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, between their flames and lovely fragrances, scented candles work wonders for relaxation and soothing the soul.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
I didn't know any of that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: On top of being sort of fashionable, they work as a nice present. I'm sure everyone is going to like them very much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree!
Um, so... Shall we start shopping for everything we'll need?
Scent Shop

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... Here?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow... Even from over here it smells really nice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... Oh, I see a whole assortment of bottles on display...! These are all scented oils...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But they have so many. I don't even know where to begin, let alone which to choose...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case... Why not choose the ones that you like the most or suit the person receiving your candle?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You can also choose based on their various properties, which should be written on their respective labels. Once you know that and how they smell, you should have an easier time choosing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That makes sense...
Thanks, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anytime!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, for now, would you all like to browse around here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I need to head over to the crafts shop over there to pick up something I ordered.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, then... Do you want me to come with you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd rather you all take your time and have fun while picking out some oils since they have so many available.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, we'll stay here and keep browsing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, they really do have a lot of choices...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, they do...
Rosemary, bergamot, clary sage, eucalyptus... They even have some blended oils.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm honestly having trouble thinking about how some of these will actually smell.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too... But they have a few samples here. Why don't we try seeing what they smell like...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, this citrusy aroma's nice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: According to the label, this is sweet orange. There's even an explanation.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Apparently, its sweet aroma helps you clear your head and feel refreshed...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see... This scent...
It reminds me of Saki.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Saki...? Oh, Tsukasa's younger sister?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Oh, actually... That makes sense since Saki has this way of cheering up everybody around her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Cheering everybody up...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It sort of also suits those two.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade, which scent is that one?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, lavender. It also has a nice sweet aroma.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Lavender? That seems like a pretty common one.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... Oh, its label even says that it's the most popular scent and how it played an important role in the development of aromatherapy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, really...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not very familiar with its history, but this gentle, flowery fragrance is so soothing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of all these scented oils, lavender in particular seems to be the most effective for relaxing oneself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, in that case... I think I'll buy some. I'd like something that will help everyone relax.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
It's not just about what suits who... We also have to think about how we want them to feel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good point. Then, why don't we keep browsing since they have so many available here?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Kusanagi, try this one.
It's supposed to smell like grapefruits.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh wow... That's such a refreshing smell... It's like there's a pile of grapefruits right in front of me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kanade, can you guess what this one smells like?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It smells sweet... And fruity... Apples?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, I thought so too at first!
Apparently, it's chamomile, but it really does smell sweet and gentle like the way apples do.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Um... Are you looking for something in particular, Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, so... I liked the lavender we sampled just now, so I was hoping to find some others that are also just as soothing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Soothing...
I think that shelf over there had more oils like that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes. Um, so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Would you like to see some together...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... Y-You're welcome...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I need a quick break...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They had so many more different aromas than I was expecting. Just looking through all of them was fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, but I started getting a little lost as to what actually smells good or nice after smelling so many.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too... However, I think we all found a few that we liked, so let's go back once we've taken a little break.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Look at that display over there... Aren't those scented candles?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you're right... I didn't know that they also sold the finished product here. They're beautiful, and so colorful.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh wow. This one looks like it has a flower inside it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I believe that's a hydrangea. It's so vivid and pretty...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It looks like they have several with different species of flowers in them. Oh, this one even has an orange and other fruits in it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It does. That's really cute...
The others would probably be so startled if I made something like this.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But that looks really difficult...
I'm not very good at making these sorts of things...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it does look difficult... B-But we should be fine since we have Honami as our teacher! So, let's give it our best shot...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... Yes, you're right.
Ah, have you all been resting at this bench?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami! Did they have what you ordered?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, and I apologize for making you all wait. So, how did things go?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, I found some that should suit Saki and the others. But we decided to take a quick break after being exposed to so many different aromas...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. Oh, did you all happen to bring the bottles too close to your noses...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Scented oils are very concentrated, so it's better to waft instead of sniff... I'm sorry. I should've mentioned this sooner.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, that's okay... I feel much better after taking a break. How about you two?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I feel much better now too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank goodness... Then, why don't we all go back in together? I should be able to give advice if you feel you need it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki.
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm glad you all found some that you liked.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. All that's left is to actually make our candles...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sure you'll do just fine.
I promise to do my best to teach you all what I can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. The plan's to make them at my house, yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. But, um... I'm really sorry to intrude since you just had me over at your house the other day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, um... M-Me too...
Especially since we really only met a second ago... I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's okay. I joined in at the last minute, so the least I could do is provide the space for us to make our candles.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, my house was a mess before, but Ms. Mochizuki's done a wonderful job of cleaning it up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... I-It's nothing. Anyway, it's fine, so don't worry about it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for being so generous, Ms. Yoisaki. We'll try not to be too much of a bother.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, shall we?
